 (APPLICATION UNDER SECTION 34 of ARBITRATION ACT, 1940) 
 
 Written Reply on behalf of Respondent / M/s Zameen Media 
 
 The Respondent /Plaintiff most respectfully submits as under: 
 
 This written reply is be ing submitted by the M/s Zameen Media (Private) Limited (hereinafter, the Company ). This written reply is being submitted by the Company t hrough Mr. Syed Hasan Ali Shah who is fully conversant with the facts of the case and has been duly authorized in this behalf. 
 
 Preliminary Objections: 
 That the instant application is not maintainable as the Applicant has already stepped into the proceedings of the court. The Applicant tendered his appearance before the court on 10-04-2023 and filed the instant application after a lapse of 10 months . H ence the instant application is not maintainable as per section 34 of the Arbitration Act, 1940. 
 
 That the instant application is not maintainable as the matter in issue does not amount to a ‘ dispute ’ , which could attract the arbitration clause, i.e., Clause 12 of the Lease Agreement dated 30-09-2020 (hereinafter, the Agreement ) . The Applicant himself admitted that he has to pay the outstanding amount to plaintiff which is clear from the H anding and T aking of P ossession F orm (Annex D to main plaint) and the same was signed by the Applicant at that time. 
 
 That by filing the titled Application, the Applicant is merely trying to avoid his contractual liability under the Lease Agreement and H anding and T aking of P ossession F orm . 
 
 
 On Merit: 
 Corresponding para needs no reply . 
 
 Corresponding para is denied being misleading and false. 
 
 Contents of the c orresponding para are misconstrued. T he matter in issue does not amount to a ‘ dispute ’, which could attract the arbitration clause, i.e., Clause 12 of the Agreement . The Applicant himself admitted that he has to pay the outstanding amount to plaintiff which is clear from the Handing and Taking of Possession Form (Annex D to main plaint) and the same was signed by the Applicant at that time. The Applicant is estopped by his own conduct. 
 
 Corresponding para is d enied being misleading . Contents of preliminary submissions may kindly be reiterated here. 
 
 Corresponding para n eeds no reply. 
 
 
 Wherefore, it is most respectfully prayed that the application/ petition under reply ma y kindly be dismissed forthwith with costs under the Islamabad Costs of Litigation Act , 2017 .
